snippet.title: Puzzles of the World - Official Early Access Release Date Trailer | Upload VR Showcase Winter 2025
snippet.description: Puzzles of the World is a virtual reality game that combines the relaxing nature of building intricate 3D miniature puzzles, with beautiful environments from around the world, or beyond. Players embark on a journey through the world’s most captivating locations, assembling miniatures of famous landmarks, objects, and scenes, while immersed in the stunning sights and sounds that bring these iconic creations to life. Tour charming locations in Puzzles of the World in this trailer ahead of the game's Early Access launch on Meta Quest on January 8, 2026.
